prompt:
Fix the schema of sections/promo-popup-trim.liquid. Do not change the markup above the {% schema %} tag. Only the JSON inside the schema block should change.

The markup strips whitespace from section.settings.heading, section.settings.body and section.settings.button_label when rendering. However, several defaults in the current schema have stray leading or trailing spaces. The markup also reads section.settings.delay_seconds, but no setting exists for it yet.

The final schema must be exactly this object, with keys and settings in this order:
- "name": "Promo popup"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "promo-popup-section"
- "settings", in this order:
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Get 10% off". The default has no leading or trailing whitespace.
  2. type "textarea", id "body", label "Body text", default "Sign up for our newsletter.". The default is trimmed.
  3. type "text", id "button_label", label "Button label", default "Shop now". The default is trimmed.
  4. type "url", id "button_link", label "Button link". This setting has no default.
  5. type "range", id "delay_seconds", label "Delay before showing", min 0, max 30, step 1, unit "s", default 5. All numbers are JSON numbers, not strings.
  6. type "checkbox", id "show_once", label "Show only once per session", default true.
- "presets": [{"name": "Promo popup"}]

No other keys are allowed. Change only sections/promo-popup-trim.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
